evals.prompt: Use Blueprint Studio to turn these three illustrations into a Style we can reuse for blog headers.
evals.expected_output: Reads list_styles, drafts a candidate with create_style, tests it on three different briefs in one batch, changes one thing per round, sets a thumbnail and reports the styleId.

evals.prompt: Our blog images all look different. Can we fix that?
evals.expected_output: Proposes a Style built and tested on three briefs, not a one-off image.

evals.prompt: Make one blog header in our existing Style.
evals.expected_output: Uses the saved styleId with the asset-generator steps. No new Style.
